map.输入建筑能耗与建筑面积，计算单位面积能耗指标（kWh/m²/年），用于建筑节能对: Enter building energy use and floor area to compute the energy-use-per-area metric (kWh/m2/year), for building energy benchmarking and efficiency assessment.
map.单位面积能耗 = 年用电量 / 建筑面积: Energy use per area = annual electricity use / floor area
map.能耗对标：录入面积与年单位能耗，对比节能标准（如 65% 节能）判断是否达标。: Energy benchmarking: enter area and annual unit energy use to compare with saving standards (e.g., 65% saving) and judge compliance.
map.改造评估：对节能改造前后录入参数，量化节能量。: Retrofit assessment: enter parameters before and after energy-saving renovation to quantify energy savings.
map.教学演示：演示单位指标×面积得总能耗的线性关。: Teaching demo: demonstrate the linear relation total energy = unit metric * area.
map.：示例：1 万 m² 建筑、单位能耗 80 kWh/m²·年，年能耗=80000: : example: 10,000 m2 building, unit energy 80 kWh/m2-year, annual energy = 800,000 kWh; if lowered to 50, annual saving 300,000 kWh.
map.单位指标哪来？: Where do the unit metrics come from?
map.按建筑类型与气候区有能耗限额标准，也可用自身历史能耗反算。结果按公开标准与环境因: Energy-limit standards exist by building type and climate zone, or derive from own historical consumption. Results are estimated per public standards and emission factors, for popular science, teaching and emission-reduction reference; for formal accounting follow official guidelines (e.g., GHG Protocol, provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.乘以电网因子得建筑运行碳排，是运行阶段主要排放来源。结果按公开标准与环境因子估算: Multiply by the grid factor to get building operating carbon emissions, the main emission source in the operation phase. Results are estimated per public standards and emission factors, for popular science, teaching and emission-reduction reference; for formal accounting follow official guidelines (e.g., GHG Protocol, provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.运行能耗易算；建材与施工(隐含碳)另计，全口径需含 embodied carbo: Operating energy is easy to compute; building materials and construction (embodied carbon) are separate; full scope must include embodied carbon. Results are estimated per public standards and emission factors, for popular science, teaching and emission-reduction reference; for formal accounting follow official guidelines (e.g., GHG Protocol, provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
